selected: IC-SEARCH / Brave Search API plus authorized HTTP fetch
implemented_target: Brave Search API plus authorized HTTP fetch
contract: GET api.search.brave.com/res/v1/web/search with admitted q/count/country/freshness; JSON result links become untrusted Sources. Fetch exact approved HTTPS URLs through G, pin resolved public IP set for the attempt, reject loopback/private/link-local/metadata, user-info URLs, DNS rebinding, unsupported MIME, decompression bombs and redirects until separately authorized. Extract text in X without scripts.
limit: Query itself is a disclosure and a priced call. Company/private terms require destination authorization; sensitive retrieval never leaks a private query through a supposedly public search. Capture results and fetch bytes/date/status; C05 freshness and source quality govern use. Research success is the domain research predicate, not result count.
simpler_alternative: A human supplies known URLs or documents at no API charge. Brave adds explicit search capability with visible unit pricing; native browser/search surfaces remain disabled in the baseline. [API](https://brave.com/search/api/).
columns: Authority, successful completion and failure behavior

contract: Dedicated company intake mailbox and a separately administered continuity mailbox. JMAP Session discovery from the pinned service, Email/query + Email/get, Email/changes and state cursor; raw RFC 5322/MIME export for evidence. Poll every 60 s, reconcile at least hourly; event hints accelerate but never replace cursor recovery. CannotCalculateChanges triggers bounded paginated rescan with gaps shown.
limit: Read-only application token where available; e-mail content cannot issue grants. Stable account+Email ID and Message-ID/content correlation distinguish duplicate from separate delivery. Attachments quarantine in X. Inbound receipts are potential customer/complaint obligations before qualification. Full mailbox returns native failure, triggers custodians and published alternative.
simpler_alternative: IMAP UIDVALIDITY/UID polling is feasible but JMAP provides typed state changes. No self-hosted SMTP server, spam daemon or per-message inbound billing. [Fastmail developer interface](https://www.fastmail.com/dev/), [JMAP mail standard](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc8621), [limits](https://www.fastmail.help/hc/en-us/articles/1500000277382-Account-limits).
columns: Authority, successful completion and failure behavior

contract: POST /email with exact approved From/To/ReplyTo/Subject/TextBody/HtmlBody, message stream, tag and opaque operation metadata. Protected connector holds a server token. Persist returned MessageID/ErrorCode; delivery/bounce/spam webhooks are verified ingress observations and reconciled with native message queries. Provider suppression API and company Suppression records both gate every send. The concrete transport boundary, the permitted mail forms, inbound event identity and the outward-field constraints are in [section 9](#9-outbound-mail-transport-event-identity-and-disclosure), which also records that this provider publishes **no** webhook signatures, so "verified ingress" here means the origin-authentication contract specified there and nothing stronger.
limit: No native exactly-once claim. Lost acknowledgement is unknown; do not blindly resend. Delivery is separate from recipient understanding or satisfaction. Default tracking off. Transactional and consented broadcast streams are separate. New cold outreach needs an exact audience/standing/content policy and grant, never arbitrary scraped recipients. A stop/suppression prevents new sends, but cannot retract an already delivered message.
simpler_alternative: Fastmail human send is the continuity/manual channel; broad Gmail/Workspace administration and CRM are unnecessary baseline dependencies. [send contract](https://postmarkapp.com/developer/api/email-api), [suppression](https://postmarkapp.com/developer/api/suppressions-api), [pricing](https://postmarkapp.com/pricing).
columns: Authority, successful completion and failure behavior

selected: IC-PUBLIC / Cloudflare Workers Static Assets + Workers Free + D1 Free
implemented_target: Cloudflare Workers Static Assets + Workers Free + D1 Free
contract: X builds immutable versioned assets and a TypeScript Worker; protected connector uploads exact manifest assets, creates a version and activates only its admitted digest. Public GET serves assets; POST /intake accepts bounded UTF-8 form/JSON, no attachments, ≤16 KiB, stores a unique submission ID, payload digest and envelope-encrypted payload for the admitted company recipient key in D1 before returning a staged receipt. Poll/export to A imports idempotently into a Case; only the later company receipt states witnessed acceptance.
limit: Separate Cloudflare customer/product account from A/R; scoped deployment token in connector, never model. Worker has only its product D1 binding and no core credentials or arbitrary outbound proxy. Free plan, fail-closed route, no paid upgrade; quota exhaustion returns actual failure and points to the independent mailbox. Public content persists as an AccessDescendant until removed and checked. Customer product fulfillment requires observed public version, functional/accessibility tests, data export/recovery and beneficiary acceptance, not upload acknowledgement.
simpler_alternative: A separate Linux public VM would add patching and ingress isolation; metered paid Workers adds unsolicited-request financial exposure. Free is selected for bounded final workloads with truthful service limits; paid migration is a reviewed commercial change, not automatic fallback. [assets](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/static-assets/), [limits](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/platform/limits/), [D1 pricing and quota failure](https://developers.cloudflare.com/d1/platform/pricing/).
columns: Authority, successful completion and failure behavior

contract: Exact account-scoped Checkout Session per accepted offer/amount/currency/customer; provider idempotency key bound to the immutable request. Signed webhooks use exact raw bytes, timestamp tolerance and event-ID inbox dedup. Poll Checkout/PaymentIntent/Refund and paginated BalanceTransactions for reconciliation; store native IDs, fees, currency, status and settlement source. Refund is its own OperationIntent linked to original payment.
limit: Actual principal eligibility, active account, permitted product and supported settlement currency are admission inputs. Checkout creates a continuing exposure: hold inventory/service capacity until native expiry or verified cancellation, including unknown creation. Expire open sessions on offer stop; completed payments remain obligations. Refund acknowledgement is not settled refund. Native idempotency retention and parameter semantics bound retries; after retention, reconcile rather than reuse a key blindly.
simpler_alternative: Manual bank transfer against a real invoice is the selected fallback where a competent operator/account exists; no invented foreign entity or account. Not a generic unconfigured payment tool. [Checkout](https://docs.stripe.com/api/checkout/sessions/create), [expiry](https://docs.stripe.com/api/checkout/sessions/expire), [refund](https://docs.stripe.com/api/refunds/create), [idempotency](https://docs.stripe.com/api/idempotent_requests), [webhooks](https://docs.stripe.com/webhooks).
columns: Authority, successful completion and failure behavior

contract: Actual authorized custodian uploads the bank's original camt.053 XML or immutable native CSV/PDF statement through authenticated intake, with account, period, opening/closing balance and source origin. Account-specific versioned mapping produces canonical integer-minor-unit transactions and a generated hledger journal; never execute user-supplied hledger include/rules/commands. hledger --strict validates a generated file; reports export CSV/JSON. Stripe balance transactions reconcile processor clearing separately from bank cash.
limit: Duplicate keys include source account, period, native transaction ID and reversal relation. Missing statement period, unmatched amounts, unknown exchange rates and opening-balance disagreement block close. Actual accountant decides applicable books/taxes/filings, signs the exact period and supplies native submission receipt. A balanced journal does not establish tax compliance, cash receipt or professional competence.
simpler_alternative: A full SaaS accounting integration is unnecessary before actual jurisdiction/chart needs exist. Deterministic portable journal plus qualified human close is an actual performance route with an accepted engagement, not a summary packet. [hledger manual](https://hledger.org/1.52/hledger.html), [ISO 20022 message definitions](https://www.iso20022.org/iso-20022-message-definitions).
columns: Authority, successful completion and failure behavior

selected: IC-HUMAN / authenticated service portal + Fastmail + actual performance
implemented_target: authenticated service portal + Fastmail + actual performance
contract: Performer receives exact scope, authority, materials, fees, deadline, evidence requirements and escalation route. Acceptance binds an identified Principal, Mandate, competence evidence, conflict check, availability and fee reservation. An authenticated acknowledgement starts performance; uploaded work/native receipt and beneficiary response are independently assessed. A phone/physical act is recorded by the responsible human with source receipt/witness and uncertainty.
limit: Applies to legal/accounting/professional judgment, research interviews, negotiation, customer support and physical delivery. Due service cannot be closed by a refusal or a packet. Missing performer acceptance means no verified capacity; existing duties trigger an actually accepted alternate, renegotiation or accountable failure/grievance path. Manual provider-console actions are attributed human external acts under standing, not falsely claimed as G-controlled requests.
simpler_alternative: Hiring every discipline as a permanent department is unnecessary; accepted scoped professional contracts and named continuity custodians provide real capacity. Provider/jurisdiction/fee/principal selection is operating admission data and must be completed before the relevant sale or due act.
columns: Authority, successful completion and failure behavior
